reason: 让 relay 在 Windows 上可用并在用户的 Windows 本机实测。新增 src/platform.mjs 集中平台差异：按 PATH/PATHEXT 解析命令，把 npm/pnpm 的 .cmd 外壳解析成“node + 脚本”直接启动（不经 cmd.exe，多行任务原样传递），Windows 用 taskkill /T /F 结束进程树、子进程 windowsHide，检查命令走 Node 的 shell 选项（POSIX /bin/sh，Windows cmd.exe，可配 checks.shell）。worker 每秒读取消标记，Windows 上 relay_cancel 只设标记不发信号；原子写的 rename 遇 EPERM/EBUSY/EACCES 短暂重试；doctor 显示各执行者的启动方式。.claude-plugin/plugin.json 只改版本号为 0.2.0。验证：新增平台测试（在 Linux 上注入 win32），现有 72 项测试不改断言通过；之后用电脑操控在用户 Windows 上用真实 codex、claude、dsh 各跑一个小任务。

en.reason: Make the relay work on Windows and test it on the user's Windows machine. A new src/platform.mjs holds the platform differences: commands resolve through PATH and PATHEXT; npm/pnpm .cmd shims resolve to node plus their script and start without cmd.exe, so multi-line tasks pass verbatim; on Windows process trees end with taskkill /T /F and children start with windowsHide; checks run through Node's shell option (/bin/sh on POSIX, cmd.exe on Windows, configurable as checks.shell). The worker reads the cancel flag every second, and on Windows relay_cancel only sets the flag; atomic renames retry briefly on EPERM/EBUSY/EACCES; doctor shows how each executor starts. .claude-plugin/plugin.json changes only its version, to 0.2.0. Verification: new platform tests (win32 injected on Linux) and the existing 72 tests unchanged; then a small job each for real codex, claude and dsh on the user's Windows machine through computer use.

reason: 第 1 组：新增 src/platform.mjs（resolveCommand、killTree、childSpawnOptions、checkShell、renameWithRetry），平台、环境和 spawnSync 可注入，并用注入 win32 的测试覆盖 Windows 分支。

en.reason: Group 1: add src/platform.mjs (resolveCommand, killTree, childSpawnOptions, checkShell, renameWithRetry) with injectable platform, environment and spawnSync, and tests that cover the Windows branch by injecting win32.

reason: 第 2 组：接入平台模块。runProcess 用 childSpawnOptions 与 killTree，退出后管道未关闭时限时收尾；检查走 Node 的 shell（可配 checks.shell）；worker 每秒读取消标记，执行前经 resolveCommand 解析命令；执行者环境白名单补上 Windows 必需的变量（SystemRoot、USERPROFILE、APPDATA 等）；store 与 config 的原子写改用 renameWithRetry。

en.reason: Group 2: wire in the platform module. runProcess uses childSpawnOptions and killTree and finishes within a limit when pipes stay open after exit; checks run through Node's shell option (configurable as checks.shell); the worker reads the cancel flag every second and resolves the executor command with resolveCommand; the executor allow-list gains the variables Windows needs (SystemRoot, USERPROFILE, APPDATA and more); store and config atomic writes use renameWithRetry.

reason: 第 3 组：relay 工具面。createRelay 接受 platform：Windows 上 relay_cancel 只设标记，由 worker 每秒读到后自行结束进程树并记录 cancelled；worker 进程以 windowsHide 启动；doctor 显示平台与各执行者的启动方式，--version 探测经 resolveCommand。

en.reason: Group 3: tool surface. createRelay takes platform: on Windows relay_cancel only sets the flag, which the worker reads within a second before ending the process tree and recording cancelled; the worker process starts with windowsHide; doctor shows the platform and how each executor starts, and probes --version through resolveCommand.

reason: 第 4 组：版本与文档。.claude-plugin/plugin.json 只把版本号改为 0.2.0；README 中英、docs/planners.md 写明 Windows 已支持及注意事项（检查默认走 cmd.exe、可配 checks.shell、.cmd 外壳被解析为 node 加脚本），删去“不支持 Windows”；docs/design.md 新增 Windows 一节。

en.reason: Group 4: version and documentation. .claude-plugin/plugin.json changes only its version, to 0.2.0; the README (both languages) and docs/planners.md state Windows support and its notes (checks default to cmd.exe, checks.shell is configurable, .cmd shims resolve to node plus script) and drop 'Windows is not supported'; docs/design.md gains a Windows section.

reason: 云端验证：副本一致性、npm test（含平台测试）、插件校验、mod 测试、tsc 与零依赖检查；之后在用户 Windows 本机实测。

en.reason: Cloud verification: the copy check, npm test (with the platform tests), plugin validation, mod tests, tsc and the no-dependency check; then the real run on the user's Windows machine.

reason: 按 Windows 本机实测的结果修复：① 用户的 Claude Code 2.1.220 不认识 --permission-prompts，-p 模式下需要授权的操作本来就会被自动拒绝，因此去掉该参数，review 档不再传 --permission-mode（新版的 manual 在旧版叫 default），写入档仍用 acceptEdits；② dsh.cmd 是 DSH Desktop 的启动脚本（设 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 等变量后用 DSH Desktop.exe 运行 desktop-cli.js），新增对“带 set 变量的绝对路径启动行”外壳的解析，连同变量一起传给执行者；③ Windows 没有 HOME，用户级配置改为回退到 USERPROFILE；④ 面向人的输出把箭头改成 ASCII 的 ->，避免 PowerShell 5.1 的代码页乱码。

en.reason: Fixes from the real run on Windows: (1) the user's Claude Code 2.1.220 rejects --permission-prompts, and in -p mode anything needing permission is denied anyway, so the flag goes and the review tier passes no --permission-mode (the newer 'manual' is 'default' in older versions), while write tiers keep acceptEdits; (2) dsh.cmd is DSH Desktop's launcher (it sets ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE and other variables, then runs desktop-cli.js with DSH Desktop.exe), so shims whose launch line is an absolute program path with set variables are now read, and those variables reach the executor; (3) Windows has no HOME, so the user config falls back to USERPROFILE; (4) human-readable output uses ASCII -> instead of arrows that PowerShell 5.1's code page garbles.
